color.note: Six brand colours from the Instik Brand Guide (Draft 1), plus five derived helpers marked 'Derived'. Light theme only for now.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand Background. Default page ground; the reading surface for long text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Derived. Cards, inputs, the video panel and sheets sitting on cream.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand Primary dark. All body text and headings (14.2:1 on cream). Also the label colour on coral and teal fills.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Brand Secondary text. Metadata, captions, helper text (5.5:1 on cream, 5.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand Primary accent. FILL ONLY: primary buttons, the hours counter ring, active states. Put ink labels on it (5.5:1); white on coral fails (2.8:1). Never use as text on cream (2.6:1).

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Derived. Coral for small text and links on cream or paper (4.7:1).

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Derived. Soft coral wash: selected chips, hover rows, the current word highlight in transcripts.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Brand Secondary accent. Fills for progress, roadmap stages reached and the understand check; ink labels on it (4.9:1). Not text on cream (2.9:1).

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Derived. Teal for small text and icons on cream (5.2:1).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Brand Highlight. Small moments only: new-word marker, a milestone, the waitlist badge. Ink on sun (10:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Derived. Borders and dividers (ink at 12%). Input borders use slate for 3:1.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Nunito, the warm rounded sans from the guide's candidates. Provisional until the wordmark is designed.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your scroll time, but it counts.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: 12 hours of Egyptian Arabic so far. Nice.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Watch real people speak Egyptian Arabic, at your level.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your next video is ready when you are.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Video metadata, helper text, in slate.

styles.name: translit
styles.usage: Transliteration line under Arabic in transcripts. Standard still to be decided.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: Arabic sits larger than Latin so the two look balanced. Always dir=rtl and lang=arz.

styles.name: arabic-ui
styles.usage: Arabic inside UI: the understand check, Arabic labels, wordmark companion text.

styles.name: transcript
styles.usage: Transcript lines with tashkeel. Generous line height so vowel marks never collide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, default gap.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Video cards, panels, the player.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Level badges, toggles, the hours pill.

shadow.note: Soft and low. Calm, not floating.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on cream.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Word tooltip, menus, the end-of-session sheet.
